newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria says not in the market for wheat.
newsitem.headline: Algeria says not in the market for wheat.

text.p: Algeria's grain office on Monday denied trade reports that it was in the market to import 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat.
"That is not correct. We did not launch a tender," an official for the Office Algerien Interprofessionnel des Cereales told Reuters.
The official added that Algeria had no immediate plans to tender for wheat.
According to U.S. trade reports, Algeria was expected to seek 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat last Friday, which would include French, U.S. or Argentine wheat.
Shipment was slated for last-half December.
